name: Home Depot SDC - Mira Loma CA

fieldNotes.truckGate: Very large fenced SDC truck yards on both long faces; striped checkpoint pinch-point lane markings observed at the SE corner where the access road meets the truck yard — a controlled entrance.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No standalone guard booth positively resolved on satellite imagery; the dock yards are open paved aprons inside the property fence. HD's practice at large DCs likely includes a staffed gate, but imagery could not confirm a booth — call flagged as uncertain.
fieldNotes.remoteGs: Set true on the basis truckGate is true and no booth was confirmed; flagged as uncertain.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Dock doors run along both N and S long faces of the building (cross-dock SDC).
fieldNotes.multipleFacilities: Single physical building, but it houses five HD DC operations (DCs #5556-5559, #5645) under one roof — set false because it is one building cluster, not a campus of separate buildings.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Very wide paved truck yards leave ample room for express/bypass lanes.
fieldNotes.dropYard: Hundreds of trailers parked along both dock-yard faces; dedicated trailer storage rows.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Located in the Mira Loma / Jurupa Valley industrial cluster of the Inland Empire — the densest warehouse fabric in the US; Urban.
fieldNotes.truckGateCount: Estimated 2 truck entrances (one per long-face yard); not all positively confirmed.
fieldNotes.dockDoorCount: ~360 doors estimated across both faces of this ~700m-long building; approximate.
